post_force: First assert all native/fixed momentum float sigma values follow the prescribed policy and physical native18/geometry/IDs/selectors remain unchanged. Compare every native actual Ace component to its independent reference. Independently reconstruct pair reactions from ACTUAL ghost float stress inputs and preflight geometry/volumes, compare them to the prescribed reaction, and balance them with the actual current-mass native fluid resultant under the retained global budget. These are derived discrete reactions, not instrumented force values on fixed particles.
nonvacuity: FS releases incompatible initial shear locally while its symmetric total force and wall reaction remain zero within the original global budget. NS has nonzero +z left/-z right reactions and a preflight balanced regular local stencil. Mixed has a nonzero negative-z fluid resultant balanced by its single positive-z left NS reaction; no false fluid-only zero condition. Rz/(tau*Lz),Lz=1/16,is a descriptive continuum/quadrature diagnostic only, with no fitted scaling or percentage gate.
